data.long_meaning: Derived from Susanna in the Old Testament, meaning 'lily' or 'grace'. In the biblical story, Susanna is falsely accused of adultery but is saved by Daniel. The name Susette carries the meaning “Grace, sweetness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Susette usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, sweetness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of grace, purity, and strength.
data.etymology: Susette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, sweetness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Susette total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Susette gained popularity in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, particularly in the French-speaking world due to the well-known character Susanne/Susette in the operetta "Fra Diavolo." Her character is depicted as an innocent, graceful young woman, adding to the appeal of the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Susette is derived from Susanna in the Old Testament, a woman of great virtue, who was falsely accused of adultery yet upheld her honor and faith. This name carries the spiritual significance of grace, purity, and strength in the face of adversity. It serves as a reminder to remain steadfast in one’s faith and virtues, even during challenging times.
